The AbhiHub story

Learning gets better
when knowledge moves.

AbhiHub brings engineering study resources into one organised library—made to help students find what they need and share what they know.

Explore the library →
Chapter 01

It started with a familiar study problem.

Useful notes, previous-year questions, and practical resources can end up scattered across chats and folders. Finding the right material becomes its own task.

AbhiHub began as a student initiative at G. H. Raisoni College of Engineering in Nagpur, with a simple idea: make shared academic material easier to find and use.

Started2025
First campusG. H. Raisoni College of Engineering
CityNagpur, India
Chapter 02

A library built around how students study.

Browse previous-year question papers, study notes, and practical resources. Find material through college, department, subject, and resource type.

One place to begin. Search the library, narrow results by branch or type, and open the resource that fits your course.
Chapter 03

The community makes the library useful.

Students find materials for their courses. Contributors can share papers and notes. Submitted resources go through review before they appear in the approved library.

  1. FindSearch by college, subject, branch, or resource type.
  2. ContributeShare useful academic material with fellow students.
  3. ReviewSubmissions are checked before being added to the public archive.
